rule_or_requirement: A privileged TRAIN teacher should repeatedly complete new TRAIN layouts faster before its actions are used as labels for a pixel-only student.
observable_information: TRAIN track geometry and simulator speed for the teacher, frozen four-frame pixel action from the selected driver, and matched finish/lap metrics.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Run the frozen geometry-coast teacher and selected pixel control on newly registered TRAIN seeds 5000–5003; do not alter the teacher or checkpoint.
expected_success_endpoint: Teacher finishes all twelve new TRAIN cells with zero invalid actions and at least 3% lower median finished lap than paired control.
control: Unchanged StableRiskEnvelopeAgent over selected full-road-guard checkpoint SHA-256 3ceb5ebbe2a4bd96944649a693b8ef924c0252fa620b0fd547c7fb494afff199.
falsifier: Teacher-only nonfinish, invalid action, or less than 3% finished-lap median improvement across twelve paired TRAIN cells.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twelve paired TRAIN cells: tracks 1–3, seeds 5000–5003, twenty-four episodes total.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered 1,800-second Linux CPU diagnostic, 2,000 decisions per episode; no fresh tune or external action.
